title: deps(site): bump the markdown group across 1 directory with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the markdown group with 2 updates in the /site directory: [isomorphic-dompurify](https://github.com/kkomelin/isomorphic-dompurify) and [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked). Updates `isomorphic-dompurify` from 4.2.0 to 4.4.0
Release notes

Sourced from isomorphic-dompurify's releases.

4.4.0: Updated dependencies

  • dompurify 3.4.15 -> 3.4.16
  • jsdom 30.1.0 -> 30.1.1

4.3.0: Updated dependencies

  • jsdom 30.0.1 -> 30.1.0
  • vitest 5.0.0 -> 5.0.1 (dev)
  • @​biomejs/biome 2.5.12 -> 2.5.14 (dev)
  • lefthook 2.1.12 -> 2.1.14 (dev)
  • pnpm 12.3.4 -> 12.4.2 (tooling)

Note: jsdom 30.1.0 improves resource consumption - clearWindow() now returns the heap fully to baseline (previously ~1.7 MB residual per clear cycle).

--- ## Maintainer follow-up: lockfile fix CI failed at `npm ci` in all three install jobs (Site, Worker, LHCI): `Missing: proxy-agent@8.0.2 from lock file` plus 13 more entries. This was not an API break in either package. Dependabot's regenerated `site/package-lock.json` dropped the optional `proxy-agent >=8.0.1` peer subtree of `@puppeteer/browsers` 3.2.3, which #591's nested `puppeteer-core > @puppeteer/browsers ^3.2.3` override pulls in. CI's Node 22 ships npm 10, which records optional peers in the lock; npm 11 and Dependabot leave them out. The fix re-runs `npm install --package-lock-only` with npm 10.9.9 on top of Dependabot's lock. That adds back exactly the 14 dropped entries. Against `main`, the lock diff is now only `isomorphic-dompurify` 4.2.0 → 4.4.0 and `marked` 18.0.13 → 18.0.14. No call sites changed. The branch is merged with `main` through #584 (`d81562c`). That merge was clean, `main` touches nothing under `site/`, and npm 10 still reports the lock up to date. Verification: - Clean `npm ci` passes under npm 10 (CI) and npm 11 (local) for `site/`. - Before the merge: `astro check` 0 errors, site and worker builds pass, `npm test` 1452/1452, local `lhci autorun` passes on all 7 routes. After the merge, the strict pre-commit gate re-ran type-check, lint, tests, anti-patterns, secrets, build and both audits on the final tree. - `isomorphic-dompurify` 4.2.0 → 4.4.0 ships no code change (`npm diff` touches `package.json` only). - `marked` 18.0.14 is bug fixes only. The built `site/dist` is byte-identical to the 18.0.13 build apart from the demo search index `generatedAt` timestamp. - A 25-input corpus through `renderSafeMarkdown` (including scheme-smuggling and entity-encoded XSS inputs) shows 4 output changes from the upstream fixes. None of them emits markup or an href outside the allow-list; the new `xmpp:` autolink keeps its text and loses its href to the existing `SAFE_SCHEME` hook. - Lock integrity hashes match the registry. Site `npm audit` reports 0 at every severity, and `npm audit signatures` verifies. ## Documentation **Generated by:** oc-docs-forge **Docs changed:** none **Reader impact:** None for site visitors: rendered pages are unchanged. Contributors: until CI's npm matches npm 11/Dependabot, a site lock regenerated by Dependabot or npm 11 must be re-locked with npm 10 (`npx -y npm@10 --prefix site install --package-lock-only`), as #591 and this PR both needed. **Follow-up docs:** `specs/spec/01-tech-stack.md` still lists `isomorphic-dompurify ^3.9` (stale since the 4.1 bump, before this PR). Aligning CI's npm with Dependabot is offered as a separate task. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
